title: A migration file, from the repository to the ledger
caption: packages/db/src/migrate/*. A numbered file is applied once and never edited once merged; an R__ file is re-applied whenever its SHA-256 changes.

states.label: In the folder, not in the ledger
states.detail: Validated before any connection: name `NNNN_name.sql` or `R__name.sql`, header `-- velexis:phase`, UTF-8 without BOM, no BEGIN/COMMIT.

states.label: Refused (MigrationFilesError)
states.detail: Every problem of the folder reported at once; exit 1; nothing applied.

states.label: Applying (own transaction)
states.detail: `SET LOCAL lock_timeout 5s`, `statement_timeout 10min`. A `no-transaction` file runs statement by statement.

states.label: applied (ledger row)
states.detail: `status = applied`, `checksum` = SHA-256 of the raw bytes, `execution_ms`.

states.label: Failed (rolled back)
states.detail: No ledger row; the run stops with exit 1; files before it stay applied. A failed no-transaction file may leave statements applied (write them idempotently).

states.label: checksum_mismatch
states.detail: An applied file was edited: exit 2 before anything is applied. Fix: restore the file, add a new migration.

states.label: R__ file changed
states.detail: Platform and reference sets only; GRANT/REVOKE/COMMENT ON only.

states.label: Ledger row without file
states.detail: After rolling back to an older release: a notice on stderr, otherwise ignored.
